topic: Company linking and access type field
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the addition of an `access_type` field to linked companies within the system. This field was implemented in the user manager and requires updating in the company manager if editing rights are available. The challenge noted is that while inventory planners may need to update this field across multiple instances, other planners might only require read access.

Future steps include integrating this new field into the view layer (view/dashboard) after receiving feedback from someone regarding profile views.
decisions: The `access_type` field was added to linked companies.
action_items: Update the `access_type` field in the company manager if editing rights are available.
Integrate the new `access_type` field into the view layer (view/dashboard) after receiving feedback from someone regarding profile views.
